property_summary: After any successful fillOrder of a LONG order, positionExpirations must be set for the long position id uint256(hashOrder(order)) to block.timestamp + duration; the mutant writes it at the opposite (short) position id instead, leaving the long position's expiration unset.
change_summary: Invert the ternary so the expiration is written at positionId for long orders and at uint256(orderHash) for short orders.
